thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-1 - MeridianCapital VPC (dedicated pool) - unredacted debug logs containing customer identifiers exposed after canary deploy. Pager: oncall-sre. Incident ref: INC-2026-0628-MC.

nate: Just got paged. Seeing lines in request-debug.log with full emails, customer ids, and user display names. Deploy to meridiancapital-dedicated finished at 04:12 PDT (11:12 UTC).

oncall-sre: I'm on it. Immediate mitigation: disable debug dumps and enable request field sanitization. Tagging legal and CS.

jess-ops: Rolling back the debug flag now and applying a middleware redactor. Commands running:

```
/infra set-log-level --pool meridiancapital-dedicated --level error
/infra apply-middleware --pool meridiancapital-dedicated --name redact-sensitive-fields
```

infra-bot: Job queued: redact-sensitive-fields/meridiancapital-dedicated -> JOB_ID: 662511.

priya-cs: Customer impact: Meridian's ops reported increased 5xxs for a subset of requests between 11:10-11:15 UTC. Their compliance officer asked if we can preserve raw logs for a regulator inquiry but only if held in EU-region and never exported to the US.

marco-legal: Critical: we must treat this as potential GDPR personal data exposure. Options: 1) move raw objects to an EU-only secure bucket with EU KMS key, limited named access, short timebox, and documented legal basis; 2) perform in-place pseudonymization (hashing) and keep redacted copies; 3) if customer insists, obtain explicit written consent and signed chain-of-custody. Recommend plan: move-to-EU-hold (48 hours max) while we obtain consent, but only if we can guarantee no cross-region replication and EU KMS.

nate: Found raw files: s3://redwood-temp/meridian/raw/ (11:11-11:16 UTC). They include cleartext emails and tenant IDs.

jess-ops: Starting move to EU secure bucket with SSE-KMS (eu-west-1) and disabling replication:

```
aws s3 mv s3://redwood-temp/meridian/raw/ s3://redwood-secure-eu/meridian/raw/ --recursive --region eu-west-1 --sse aws:kms --profile infra-eu
aws s3api put-bucket-replication --bucket redwood-secure-eu-meridian --replication-configuration '{}'
```

infra-bot: Move started.

infra-bot: Move completed. Files now in s3://redwood-secure-eu/meridian/raw/; server-side encryption: aws:kms (key alias: alias/redwood-incidents-eu). Audit ticket created: AUDIT-2026-662511.

marco-legal: Please compile list of named personnel who need access and justification. Default hold while we get explicit customer authorization: 2 hours. If customer provides written request citing regulator, extend to 72 hours with signed chain-of-custody. If no request, proceed with pseudonymization and delete raw within the 2-hour window.

priya-cs: Meridian compliance replied via their secure portal: they request logs be held in EU for 48 hours and have asked for a brief field-level summary of exposed attributes. They've assigned a named contact (compliance@meridian.example) and said they'll send an authorization signed by their legal counsel within 4 hours.

oncall-sre: For access controls: applied IAM restriction to redwood-secure-eu/meridian so only principals [nate, jess-ops, oncall-sre, marco-legal] can GetObject. Enabled CloudTrail object-level logging and set MFA-delete on the bucket. Also rotated the KMS key used for that alias.

jess-ops: Rotated KMS key and created a dedicated incident CMK (alias/redwood-incidents-eu-662511). Commands run:

```
aws kms create-key --description "incident: meridian raw hold" --region eu-west-1 --profile infra-eu
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood-incidents-eu-662511 --target-key-id <KEY_ID>
```

marco-legal: Keep retention window at 2 hours by default. If the customer provides the signed authorization (scoped to EU-only access, list of named engineers, and duration), legal will approve extension to 48 hours. Any extension beyond that requires escalation to CCO. We also require a signed non-disclosure & limited-access acknowledgement from the named engineers.

nate: Preparing a pseudonymization job as fallback (hash email + truncate tenant ids). Script preview: 

```
python tools/pseudonymize.py --input s3://redwood-secure-eu/meridian/raw/ --patterns email,tenant_id --hash-salt INCIDENT-662511 --output s3://redwood-secure-eu/meridian/pseudonymized/ --dry-run
```

infra-bot: PREVIEW job scheduled: PSEUDO_PREVIEW_662511. No writes performed. Report attached to AUDIT-2026-662511.

priya-cs: Meridian compliance confirmed they'll send signed authorization but insisted on the 48-hour hold and that logs not be transferred outside EU. They also asked for a field summary: emails, internal user names, and tenant identifiers.

marco-legal: That's acceptable provided we: 1) receive the signed doc, 2) log chain-of-custody and access, 3) limit retention to 48 hours, 4) ensure keys remain in EU region. Legal to review the customer-signed PDF when received.

jess-ops: If signed consent doesn't arrive within 2 hours, we'll run the pseudonymize job and then delete raw. Pseudonymization will be irreversible-hash with recorded salt.

oncall-sre: Follow-ups: add pre-deploy gate to reject debug logging flags in dedicated pools without two-person approval; add automated scan to detect high-entropy emails in logs post-deploy; update runbook for EU/VPC customers on default redaction policy.

infra-bot: Handoff reminder scheduled in 50 minutes. Audit entries: AUDIT-2026-662511, PSEUDO_PREVIEW_662511.

priya-cs: Logging status: error spike subsided after logging change and middleware applied. Customer notified that we are holding logs under restricted EU CMK pending their signed authorization.

marco-legal: Confirming decision log: temporary EU hold (2h) in KMS-encrypted bucket; access limited to named responders; require signed authorization to extend to 48h; if no auth, pseudonymize and delete raw. Legal will attach incident-specific NDAs for named engineers.

nate: Adding this to the incident timeline and will hand off to next on-call.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (debug logging disabled, filters applied, raw logs secured in eu-west-1). Next steps: consent or pseudonymize.

priya-cs: I'll keep Meridian updated. Thanks team. :globe_with_meridians:
